body:
## Quick answer

From **27 November to 1 December 2026** every Bahe Kurtiz style is **10% off** for shoppers in the **USA, UK, Canada and Australia**. The code **BLACKFRIDAY10** is applied automatically at checkout while the sale is on – you can also type it in the coupon box. Prices are the same as the rest of the year; the 10% comes off at checkout. There are no inflated "was" prices.

## What is in the sale

Everything we make in our Jaipur unit, from everyday cotton to hand-worked festive pieces:

| Style | Usual price | Good for |
|---|---|---|
| Kurtis & cotton tunic tops | $40–$42 | Office, college, everyday |
| Kurta sets (pant or palazzo) | $51–$67 | Festivals, family dinners, gifting |
| Co-ord sets & dresses | $50–$51 (linen dresses up to $124) | Brunches, holidays, parties |
| Anarkali suits & gowns | $67–$89 | Weddings, sangeet, Christmas & New Year parties |

## Will it arrive in time for Christmas or New Year?

- **Christmas (25 Dec):** order a ready size by **27 November** – the first day of the sale.
- **New Year's Eve (31 Dec):** order a ready size by **3 December**.
- Custom-fit pieces take about a week longer to stitch, so order them sooner.

The [festival calendar](/festival/) lists every last order date.

## Sizes and fit

Ready sizes run XS–3XL (4XL in our linen and velvet styles). Use the [US/UK size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) if you are not sure of your Indian size, or choose a free custom fit on the product page.

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free express shipping** with tracking to the USA, UK, Canada and Australia – duties and taxes included, nothing to pay on delivery
- Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days, custom fit in 10–15, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **14-day returns** with a full refund on unused ready-size pieces ([international returns](/international-returns/))
- Pay by PayPal or debit / credit card in US$

## More for the season

- [Christmas ethnic wear](/festival/christmas-new-year/) – velvet, red and green looks
- [Christmas gift ideas: Indian outfits for her](/blog/christmas-gift-ideas-indian-outfits-for-her/)
- [Anarkali suits](/collections/anarkali-suits/) and [kurta sets](/collections/kurta-pant-dupatta-sets/)

faq.q: When is the Bahe Kurtiz Black Friday sale?
faq.a: From 27 November to 1 December 2026 (Black Friday to Cyber Monday, India time). Outside these dates the code does not work – the top bar of the site always shows any sale that is on today.

faq.q: Which countries get the Black Friday discount?
faq.a: Shoppers in the USA, the UK, Canada and Australia. The code is applied automatically at checkout there while the sale is on.
Yes. Our prices are the same all year and the 10% comes off at checkout. We never show made-up "was" prices.

faq.q: Can I use BLACKFRIDAY10 with another code?
faq.a: No – one code per order. During the sale BLACKFRIDAY10 replaces the first-order welcome code.

faq.q: Will my Black Friday order arrive before Christmas?
faq.a: Ready sizes ordered on 27 November arrive before Christmas. Orders from 28 November to 1 December arrive in time for New Year's Eve (order ready sizes by 3 December).
